Movie Strategy Guidebook My Nintendo Career Sitemap PEGI 18 Nintendo Switch Online features supported Stellar Blade™ Complete Edition System: Nintendo Switch 2 Release date: 05/11/2026 The future of humanity hangs by a thread. Earth has been devastated by mysterious, powerful creatures known as the Naytiba. With the planet lost, the last survivors of humanity fled to a Colony in outer space.EVE, member of the 7th Airborne Squad, descends from the Colony with a single mission: reclaim Earth and save humankind.But as she battles the Naytiba across the ruined remains of civilisation, uncovering fragments of the past, EVE begins to realise that her mission is far more complicated than it first appeared. The deeper she ventures into the fallen world, the more she discovers that almost nothing is as it seems. EXPERIENCE RAZOR-SHARP ACTION Engage in fast, stylish combat as you carve your way through the ruins of Earth. Master fluid attack combos, unlock powerful new abilities and weapon upgrades, and face intense boss encounters that will test both your reflexes and strategy. EXPLORE A HAUNTINGLY BEAUTIFUL WORLD Discover a stunning post-apocalyptic Earth brought to life through breathtaking science fiction environments. From desolate city ruins to mysterious landscapes, every location blends beauty and horror in unforgettable ways. UNCOVER A POWERFUL HUMAN STORY Follow EVE on a gripping journey filled with mystery, difficult choices and emotional revelations. Piece together the truth behind humanity’s fall and confront the hidden forces shaping the fate of the world.This edition also includes content from the 'Stellar Blade™ x NieR:Automata™' and 'Stellar Blade™ x GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE' DLCs.**Some included content becomes available after progressing through the main story. This description was provided by the publisher. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9GamesHasbro Games™ Junior CollectionReleases 11/6/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLoadingPlay Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr. Customize your avatar, unlock rewards, and enjoy local multiplayer fun for up to 4 players.Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!3 CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr.FUN FOR EVERYONE: Kid-friendly rules that are easy to learn and play fast.LOCAL MULTIPLAYER PARTY: Play together with up to 4 players on one console.CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR: Unlock fun new looks and cosmetic rewards as you play.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)1 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)GameShareLocalNintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy ViolenceGamesShrek 2 RemasteredReleases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/17/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCComic Mischief, Mild Fantasy ViolenceLoadingDreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.Travel back to a nostalgic era of gaming for some pick-up-and-play casual fun.
